findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed no sanitizer solution prepared in the facility during food preparation or service. Education was conducted and a spray bottle was prepared measuring 200ppm quaternary ammonia.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: Inspector observed no available stem thermometer for confirming proper cook temperature for TCS foods. Education was conducted an a stem thermometer was acquired. Ensure thermometers are available at all times of food prep and service.
findings.citation_text: 4-203.11 Temperature Measuring Devices, Food. (A) FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES that are scaled only in Celsius or dually scaled in Celsius and Fahrenheit shall be accurate to ±1°C in the intended range of use. (B) FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES that are scaled only in Fahrenheit shall be accurate to ±2°F in the intended range of use.

findings.title: Proper hot holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Observed cheese sauce to temp at an improper hot holding temperature. The cheese sauce was tempted at 94F (probed). It appears that the cheese dispenser isn’t functioning properly and was discarded by PIC. The cheese sauce bag was also discarded. There was a backup sauce dispenser (and cheese bag) that is going to replace the broken one. The new cheese bag was probed at 137F. Be sure  that cheese sauce is held at 135F or above to ensure proper hot holding temperatures. 

The cheese sauce was probed at 94F. Discussed with PIC and cheese sauce was discarded. The cheesedispenser wasn’t functioning properly.

3-501.16: (A) (1) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 135F or above. Roasts can be maintained at 130F or above.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 4-602.13  (C) Soil residue present on the top of storage bins, the ledge at serving window, the cabinets where there shop vac is stored. Clean all non-food contact surfaces frequently to prevent soil accumulation.  Reference 4-602.13.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(B) and (C)  (C)  Grease and soil accumulation present on the pot of the popcorn maker and the inside of the ice machine which is currently shut down and empty. Thoroughly clean all cooking equipment and pans. Reference 4-601.11(B) and (C). Clean before shutting down for the Winter and before open in the Spring. Cleaning frequency is not considered adequate to eliminate soil accumulation.
